# Odoo CRM | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Listing | CRM in the open source business application suite to share data with sales, accounting, inventory, projects, electricians and HR. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | not a case-in-box lightweight RM project; customization, upgrading and data governance may become the main TCO; first year discount does not equal the continuation fee. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | The lightweight CM project is not open; customization, upgrade and data governance may become the main TCO; the first year discount is not equal to the continuation fee. |
